name: Macquarie Park
notes: Primary Sydney hyperscaler AZ cluster. AWS ap-southeast-2, Azure, Google, Oracle all present. Most constrained land in APAC. Highest $/kW in Australia.

name: Eastern Creek / Kemps Creek
notes: Western Sydney emerging campus zone near M7. AWS and Azure announced major builds. AirTrunk, Goodman Group active. ~40km dark fibre to Macquarie Park.

name: Huntingwood
notes: Western Sydney M7 corridor. Multiple DC operators active. Proximity to Blacktown industrial zone. Good grid access. AirTrunk and others landbanking.

name: Erskine Park
notes: Western Sydney M7/M4 interchange zone. Emerging DC precinct. Large industrial land parcels. Good 132kV grid access. Close to Eastern Creek cluster.

name: Marulan / Goulburn
notes: Speculative AI stretch site. Renewable energy via Snowy Hydro corridor. ~180km from Sydney AZ — likely regional only.

name: Docklands / Port Melbourne
notes: Primary Melbourne hyperscaler AZ cluster. AWS ap-southeast-2 edge AZ, Azure, Google, Oracle. Very constrained land. Highest density in Australia.

name: Geelong
notes: 75km southwest of Melbourne CBD. Renewable energy via Western Victoria wind corridor. Government-backed digital precinct proposal. Lower cost AI campus potential.

name: Moorabool / Lara
notes: Keppel Moorabool 800MW+ AI campus under development. ~80km from Melbourne. Backed by renewable energy. One of APAC's most significant AI campus sites. Google rumoured anchor tenant.

name: Tullamarine
notes: Near Melbourne Airport. 22km from Docklands via metro fibre. Azure preference for DR AZ. Global Switch campus. Industrial land available.

name: Jurong / Tuas
notes: Primary Singapore DC hub. All major hyperscalers present. Moratorium on new DC approvals (Green Data Centre Roadmap). Highest $/kW in APAC. Effectively full.

name: Woodlands / Sembawang
notes: Northern Singapore, 30km from Jurong hub. Fibre to Johor via land cable under JB causeway. Limited additional land. Google presence via STT GDC.

name: Iskandar / Nusajaya
notes: Singapore's AI campus hinterland. ~30km from Jurong. Massive hyperscaler commitments 2024-25: Microsoft, Google, AWS, Oracle all announced. Equinix, Digital Realty, Bridge DC present. Most significant emerging AI site in APAC.

name: Kulai / Senai
notes: 50km north of Singapore. YTL DC and AirTrunk campus developments. Microsoft SEA AI campus announced. Power from Tenaga grid extension. Lower cost than Iskandar.

name: Cyberjaya
notes: Malaysia's primary DC hub, 30km south of KL. All major hyperscalers present via AIMS fibre ring. Government Digital Free Trade Zone (DFTZ) designation.

name: Shah Alam / Klang
notes: 35km west of Cyberjaya along Federal Highway. Industrial corridor with large land parcels and grid capacity. Emerging DC campus zone. Government incentive eligible.

name: Ota / Shin-Kiba
notes: Primary Tokyo hyperscaler AZ cluster. AWS ap-northeast-1, Azure Japan East, Google, Oracle all present. High density. Fibre from submarine cable landing at Chikura/Ajigaura.

name: Kawasaki / Yokohama
notes: 25km south of Tokyo CBD. Secondary AZ cluster for DR. AWS and Azure DR sites. Good fibre connectivity to Ota via metro dark fibre ring. Equinix and NTT active.

name: Inzai / Narita
notes: 40km northeast of Tokyo near Narita airport. Major emerging DC campus zone. IDC Frontier, KDDI, NTT significant presence. Submarine cable landing proximity (PCCS). Growing hyperscaler interest for large-scale AI.

name: Sagamihara / Machida
notes: 45km southwest of Tokyo. Emerging AI campus zone. Google pre-leased site. Lower land cost than core. TEPCO grid upgrade planned for increased capacity.

name: Atsugi / Ayase
notes: 60km west of Tokyo. Greenfield AI campus potential. Large industrial land. 110kV grid available. Slower fibre buildout required. Low land cost relative to Tokyo.

name: Tseung Kwan O
notes: Primary HK DC hub. AWS ap-east-1, Azure, Google, Oracle present. MEGA-i largest campus. GreenHub, iAdvantage active. Very constrained land. Political uncertainty weighs on long-term investment.

name: Tuen Mun
notes: 40km northwest of TKO. Some emerging land capacity. Longer fibre run reduces cloud attractiveness. SUNeVision and OneAsia active. Political uncertainty weighs on investment.

name: Sangam / Mapo
notes: Primary Seoul DC cluster. Digital Media City adjacent. AWS ap-northeast-2, Azure, Google Cloud, Oracle all present. High land cost but excellent connectivity.

name: Bundang / Pangyo
notes: 25km south of Seoul in Seongnam. Korea's 'Silicon Valley'. AWS DR site. Good dark fibre to Sangam via metro ring. SK Broadband and KT IDC present.

name: Incheon / Songdo
notes: 50km west of Seoul near airport. Smart city infrastructure. KAWA submarine cable landing station. Google Incheon DC. Growing AI campus potential with large land parcels.

name: Ibaraki / Takatsuki
notes: Primary Osaka hyperscaler cluster, 15km north of Osaka CBD. AWS ap-northeast-3, Azure Japan West, Google, Oracle present. Significant campus expansion ongoing 2024-25.

name: Sakai / Kishiwada
notes: 25km south of Osaka. Industrial zone with lower land cost. Renewable energy from Wakayama wind projects. Emerging AI campus zone for Osaka market.

name: Neihu / Nangang
notes: Primary Taipei DC cluster. AWS ap-east-2 (Taiwan). Constrained by dense urban build. Key for Taiwan Strait geopolitical monitoring. CHT IDC and FarEasTone dominant.

name: Taoyuan
notes: 35km west near Taoyuan Airport. Oracle and Azure DR sites. TW-1 and APG submarine cable landing nearby. Emerging campus zone with power from Taoyuan grid.

name: Navi Mumbai / Airoli
notes: Primary Mumbai hyperscaler cluster. AWS ap-south-1, Azure, Google Cloud ap-south1, Oracle present. Hiranandani campus the largest single DC campus in India. Land very constrained.

name: Taloja / Khopoli
notes: 35km south of Navi Mumbai. Large Yotta D1 campus. Power from MSEDCL grid. Emerging AI campus zone for Mumbai with larger land parcels available.

name: Pune
notes: 160km from Mumbai. Separate IT hub. Cheaper land and power. AI campus potential as standalone market. CtrlS and NxtGen present. Microsoft and Google scouting.

name: Noida / Greater Noida
notes: Primary Delhi NCR hyperscaler cluster. AWS ap-south-2, Azure India Central, Google, Oracle present. Most active DC construction market in India in 2024-25. NTT, STT GDC, Digital Realty all building.

name: Gurgaon / Manesar
notes: 30km south of Delhi. Major IT hub. Azure and Google DR sites. Power from Haryana grid with ISTS connectivity. Second DC cluster emerging alongside Noida.

name: HITEC City / Gachibowli
notes: Primary Hyderabad IT and DC hub. AWS ap-south-2 DR, Azure South India, Google Cloud ap-south2, Oracle present. Low land cost vs Mumbai/Delhi. Strong government support via T-Hub initiative.

name: Genome Valley / Kompally
notes: 25km north of HITEC City. Emerging pharmaceutical/biotech zone with 220kV grid capacity. Large land parcels at competitive cost. Telangana State incentive scheme eligible.

name: Cibinong / Sentul
notes: Primary Jakarta DC cluster, 40km south. AWS ap-southeast-3, Azure, Google Cloud ap-southeast-3 present. DCI Indonesia dominant operator. Grid capacity improving through PLN upgrades.

name: Bekasi / Karawang
notes: 25km east of Jakarta CBD. Industrial corridor. Oracle Jakarta DC. Power from PLN East Java corridor. Land at competitive cost. BKPM investment zone.

name: Banten / Cilegon
notes: 100km west of Jakarta. Industrial estate near Krakatau Steel complex power plant. Very low power cost. Greenfield AI campus potential with significant uncommitted power capacity.

name: Taguig / BGC
notes: Primary Manila DC cluster in BGC financial district. AWS ap-southeast-1 edge, Azure, Google present. Fibre from Nasugbu submarine cable landing. Meralco grid reliability improving.

name: Alabang / Muntinlupa
notes: 25km south of BGC. Emerging residential-commercial zone. STT GDC campus. Power from Meralco South grid. Lower land cost than BGC. Good fibre connectivity.

name: Clark / Pampanga
notes: 100km north of Manila in Clark Freeport Zone. BCDA digital zone. Oracle campus announced. Very low land cost. Power from Clark grid. 75MW available. Renewable energy target by 2030.

name: Nonthaburi / Bang Yai
notes: Primary Bangkok DC cluster, 15km northwest of CBD. AWS ap-southeast-1 edge, Azure, Google present. Equinix BK1 and CAT Telecom active. Limited land for expansion.

name: EEC / Chonburi
notes: 100km east of Bangkok in Eastern Economic Corridor. Major government investment zone. GULF INNOTECH and WHA industrial estate DCs. AWS and Google announced sites. EEC grid upgrade underway. Most significant AI campus development zone in Thailand.

name: Thu Duc / District 7
notes: Primary HCMC DC cluster. Thu Duc Smart City zone. AWS new region planned. Azure and Google present. Fibre from Vung Tau submarine cable landing. EVN grid upgrade ongoing.

name: Binh Duong
notes: 30km north of HCMC. Vietnam's largest industrial zone. CMC DC campus. Power from EVN grid. Land at very competitive cost. Government incentives for digital infrastructure.

name: Long An
notes: 50km southwest of HCMC. Government-backed digital zone. Very low land cost. Power from Mekong delta grid. Greenfield AI campus potential. Slow permitting is key risk.

name: Albany / North Shore
notes: Primary Auckland DC cluster, 20km north of CBD. AWS ap-southeast-2 edge, Azure, Microsoft present. Limited by NZ grid constraints and high capex cost. Datacom and Spark dominant.

name: South Auckland / Wiri
notes: 20km south of Auckland CBD. Industrial zone. Power from Vector Wiri substation. Land available. Limited hyperscaler interest to date but growing as north Auckland fills.
